title: A macrophage-T cell coculture model for severe tissue injury-induced T cell death
protocol: Euthanize BL6/J mouse.
Disinfect and fixate the mouse in a supine position.
Carefully expose femur and tibia from surrounding muscles and tissue.
Store prepared bones in 10 mL of ice-cold PBS for transfer to laminar air flow.
Remove the epiphyses from femurs and tibias.
Flush out the bone marrow from femurs and tibiae onto a 40 μm strainer using a 23 G needle on a 1 mL syringe filled with sterile PBS.
Use additional 10 mL PBS to flush remaining cells through the strainer into a conic tube.
Fill up volume in the conic tube with PBS to 20 mL.
Wash cells by centrifuging the tube at 500 g for 8 min at room temperature.
Resuspend bone marrow-derived cells in 20 mL PBS and wash again at 500 g for 8 minutes.
Seed bone marrow-derived cells in culture dishes for differentiation.
Resuspend with 2 mL BMDM medium and count cells using a Neubauer counting chamber or an automated cell counter.
Prepare a cell suspension containing 3–5 × 10^7 bone marrow-derived cells in 2 mL BMDM medium (1.5–2.5 × 10^6 cells per mL).
Seed the cell suspension on a 15 cm cell culture dish.
Add 150 ng of M-CSF to each culture dish and provide additional 13 mL of BMDM medium.
Place the cells in an incubator at 37°C.
Provide 150 ng of M-CSF and 3 mL BMDM medium to each culture dish daily for another 4 continuous days.
Harvest and seed differentiated BMDMs on 96-well plates.
Remove the medium from the culture dish containing differentiated BMDMs.
Wash the dish twice by slowly pouring 10 mL pre-warmed PBS over it, panning and removing the PBS.
Add 10 mL pre-warmed PBS and detach the cells by gentle scraping with a cell scraper.
Collect the cell suspension in a conical 50 mL tube.
Check the dish visually for remaining cells.
Repeat scraping with another 10 mL PBS if necessary, collecting in the same conical 50 mL tube.
Add PBS to bring the total volume of the cell suspension up to 20 mL.
Wash the cell suspension at 300g for 7 minutes at room temperature.
Wash again at 300 g for 7 minutes at room temperature.
Resuspend cells in 2 mL BMDM medium after discarding supernatant.
Seed 1 × 10^5 BMDMs per well into a flat-bottom 96-well plate.
Place the seeded cells in an incubator at 37°C to settle and ramify overnight (12–18 hours).
Euthanize Bl6/J mouse, disinfect and fixate it in supine position.
Open the abdomen and expose the spleen from surrounding fat tissue.
Remove the spleen and store in 10 mL of ice-cold PBS for transfer to laminar air flow.
Prepare a conic 50 mL tube and a 40 μm strainer.
Mince the spleen using scissors.
Press tissue through the 40 μm strainer with a syringe plunger while continuously rinsing with at least 10 mL of PBS.
Fill up the volume to at least 20 mL.
Wash the suspension at 300 g for 10 min at room temperature.
Acquire cell numbers and titrate the concentration to 10^7 cells per 100 μL.
Transfer the whole cell suspension into a 5 mL “FACS” tube.
Add 20 μL of the T cell enrichment antibody cocktail per 100 μL cell suspension.
Vortex briefly at least three times.
Incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Bring the suspension volume up to 4 mL with Hank’s balanced salt solution (HBSS).
Wash at 300 g for 8 min at room temperature.
Discard supernatant and resuspend with 100 μL HBSS per 10^7 cells.
Add 20 μL of the magnetic bead-labeled antibodies per 100 μL cell suspension.
Vortex briefly at least three times.
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Bring the volume up to 2.5 mL with HBSS.
Place the FACS tube into the supplied magnet for 5 min at room temperature.
Decant carefully the suspension from the “magnetized” tube into a fresh 4 mL FACS tube (= enriched T cells).
Wash the enriched T cells at 300 g for 8 min (room temperature).
Acquire cell numbers and titrate to a concentration of 3 × 10^5 cells per 200 μL with T cell medium.
Place 200 μL T cell suspension per well onto a U-bottom 96-well plate pre-coated with CD3e antibody.
Let the cells settle for 15 min.
Add CD28 antibody (10 μL; 0.1 μg/μL) to the T cells.
Place the cells overnight into an incubator at 37°C.
Control the viability of T cells before starting the coculture approach.
Prime BMDMs with LPS for inflammasome activation by diluting 100 ng/mL LPS in BMDM medium.
Incubate the primed BMDMs for 4 hours at 37°C in the incubator.
Visually inspect cells 2 hours after starting priming.
Carefully pipette T cells out of U-bottom wells into a 15 mL conic tube prepared with 2 mL pre-warmed T cell medium.
Wash the cells at 300 g for 10 minutes (room temperature).
Resuspend T cells in 2 mL pre-warmed T cell medium and titrate the concentration appropriate for cell-cell interaction.
Remove carefully the medium from the BMDMs.
Provide "Inflammasome stimulation medium" to the BMDMs immediately after removing the old medium.
Keep cells in the incubator at 37°C for the stimulation.
Remove “Inflammasome stimulation medium” from BMDMs.
Wash BMDMs once with 200 μL of serum-free RPMI 1640 complete medium.
Add 100 μL of serum-free RPMI 1640 complete medium to the washed BMDMs.
Add T cells (2 × 10^5 cells in 200 μL T cell medium per well) to the BMDMs.
Ensure the total volume is 300 μL per well.
Optional: Centrifuge the 96-well plate at 300 g for 1 minute to settle T cells on BMDMs.
Incubate the coculture in an incubator at 37°C until the end of the experiment.
Perform microscopy-based analysis by live counting of GFP+ T cells in distinct fields of view.
Conduct histology analysis of fixed cocultures.
Harvest cells 2–6 hours after the initiation of the cell–cell interaction phase.
Remove medium from the wells during the last 10 minutes of the cell–cell interaction phase.
Wash cells once with 1 mL HBSS.
Carefully harvest cells using a cell scraper and transfer them to FACS tubes.
Bring the volume in the tubes to 2 mL by adding additional HBSS.
Keep the tubes on ice.
Wash cells at 300 g for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL of FACS staining buffer.
Incubate cells with 1 μL Fc blocker (0.5 μg/mL) in the dark at 4°C for 15 minutes.
Add antibody cocktail (0.5 μg/mL per antibody) to the cells.
Incubate cells with the antibody cocktail in the dark at 4°C for 30 minutes.
Wash cells at 300 g for 7 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Repeat washing step once more to improve cleanness.
Bring the cell suspension volume to 2 mL with FACS staining buffer.
Wash cells again at 300 g for 7 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 200 μL of FACS staining buffer.
Start acquisition.
